title: Oliver Wine Tour Full Day Guided With 5 Wineries
includes: Hotel / accommodation pick up and drop off included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to your Oliver Wine tour! Experience the BEST Oliver Wine Tours in the heart of the Wine Capital of Canada. The unique terroir of the Golden Mile Bench and Black Sage Bench set the scene for over 50 wineries. With endless sunshine, handcrafted wines and an intimate experience within one of Canada’s most iconic wine regions, you will be sure to fall in love with this desert like region! This action packed wine experience offers access to the absolute best of the Okanagan wine culture. The further south you go, the bigger and bolder the reds become! With 5 winery visits on this tour, the Oliver Wine Tour truly offers something for all wine lovers.

This full day (~7 hours) Oliver Wine Tour offers access to Oliver's most sought after wineries and includes a lunch stop with reservations at a winery restaurant.
